hypotheses.title: CD44-mediated metastatic vulnerability combined with immune-niche intervention
hypotheses.plain_language_summary: This research hypothesis asks whether targeting a CD44-linked metastatic process together with tumour-microenvironment immune suppression is worth testing as a combined osteosarcoma research strategy.
hypotheses.hypothesis_statement: In metastatic osteosarcoma, suppressing a CD44-associated transendothelial and metastatic phenotype while separately reversing suppressive bone or pulmonary immune-niche conditions may warrant investigation as a combined research strategy rather than treating either biological layer as sufficient on its own.
